title: ArcCivs manual foundation earthworks
assumptions: Low/base/high assume 0.1/1/4 accepted foundations per player-day, 64/512/4096 world DIRT fill blocks per foundation, and 0.25/1/4 active player-hours per day. These are scenarios, not observed activity or daily limits.

Each accepted plan changes at most 32768 cells and reads at most 131072 cells. Changed cells include AIR cuts as well as fills; any cut reduces the maximum possible DIRT fill count. The 32768 figure is a per-plan ceiling, not a daily or lifetime cap.

World DIRT is not a player-inventory item when generated. Application writes block data directly, uses no breakNaturally/inventory transfer/physics and pays no direct Vault, tokens or XP. No player inventory is debited; authored building material prices remain unchanged; prior manual supports are not generated retroactively.

Conditional current SELL exposure assumes every generated DIRT fill can later be removed, obtained and sold with no loss at tracked nominal price 1 Vault/item. This is not guaranteed or ArcCivs-attributable income. Recent unrelated DIRT sales establish a current channel but do not show foundation-block mining or resale.

Observed read-only 168-hour ledger snapshot generated 2026-10-24: 87 DIRT sold for 86.77 Vault across 2 transactions by 1 player, effective 0.9973563 Vault/item. Use the tracked nominal 1 Vault/item for the ceiling rather than treating the realized average as a changed price.
participants [1,1,1] represents one hypothetical participant for per-player weekly arithmetic, not online population or network activity. No network estimate is made.

ArcCivs protects authored building footprints and the settlement radius itself grants no event protection; whether support blocks outside footprints are mineable depends on location and other active runtime claim protections. No universal removability assumption is asserted outside the conditional ceiling.

EconomyShopGUI SELL is current and modeled separately from the future SELL-off target. After actual SELL-off, DIRT shop redemption is zero unless a separately active, budgeted DIRT contract exists; no such future income is assumed.

Decision: permit the requested bounded support fill without adding a new economic restriction, price or contract. Direct Vault/tokens/XP changes are zero; item-unit generation and conditional resale remain separate. Source, delivery, activation and observed behavior are separate evidence layers.

flows.basis: One event is one world DIRT fill block. Assumed foundation rates and fill volumes yield 6.4/512/16384 fill blocks per player-day; blocks are written into the world, not awarded to player inventory.

Conditional after-only all-generated-fills-recovered-and-sold ceiling at current tracked nominal 1 Vault per DIRT; no plugin payout is added. After actual SELL-off this flow is zero absent a separately active, budgeted contract.
